question: restaurants within 500m of a landmark
sql: WITH landmarks AS (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_places WHERE taxonomy->'primary' = 'historic_site') SELECT p.names->'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p, landmarks l WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, l.geometry) < 500

question: count of places by category with more than 100 instances
sql: SELECT basic_category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM lisbon_places GROUP BY basic_category HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY count DESC

question: find places with multiple websites
sql: SELECT id, names->'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(websites) > 1

question: average distance from central Lisbon to all restaurants
sql: WITH central AS (SELECT ST_Point(-9.1333, 38.7033) AS center) SELECT AVG(ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, c.center)) AS avg_distance FROM lisbon_places p, central c WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant'

question: list places with names in English vs other languages
sql: SELECT id, names->'primary' AS name, CASE WHEN names->'rules' IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_rules' ELSE 'no_rules' END AS naming_style FROM lisbon_places WHERE names->'primary' IS NOT NULL

question: find places within 1km of a specific point
sql: WITH target_point AS (SELECT ST_Point(-9.14, 38.71) AS pt) SELECT id, names->'primary' AS name FROM lisbon_places p, target_point t WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(p.geometry, t.pt) < 1000
